purpose: Test whether interpreting the P0667 multipole invariant as a quadratic field-power fraction, and therefore applying its square root to the field amplitude, supplies a measurable cluster channel while remaining dormant in registered galaxies.

candidate.sigma: A times the P0666 physical-length local 3D activation
candidate.surface_to_volume: sech-squared with component scale height equal to its projected RMS radius
candidate.map_resolution: each component is conservatively anti-aliased to the common 33-cell cubic grid before lifting
candidate.physical_rationale: field energy or power is quadratic in field amplitude, so a dimensionless routed-power fraction M corresponds to the unique nonnegative amplitude fraction sqrt(M)

selection_rule: The sole nonnegative amplitude interpretation advances to a spent RX J2129 3D map build only if every registered coverage, mass, scale-height, ellipticity, absolute-channel, domain-separation, sensitivity, parameter, and blindness gate passes.
claim_boundary: P0669 changes the constitutive activation law but does not yet derive it from a covariant action or quantized gravity theory.
The square root is not a fitted exponent: it is fixed by the declared amplitude-versus-quadratic-power interpretation.
P0669 tests coefficient transfer and does not solve the nonlinear tensor field or compare a target outcome.
No spent RX J2129 image and no P0633/P0640 target may be used in P0669 development or selection.
